text: {"behavior": "ANSWER", "answer": "Before selling your car without a loan, you need to ensure the following: (1) The vehicle is free from any encumbrances, including hypothecation or loan agreements. (2) You have the original Registration Certificate (RC) and all valid documents such as insurance, PUC, and fitness certificate. (3) You must report the sale in Form 29 within 14 days of the transfer. (4) The buyer must apply for transfer of ownership in Form 30 within 14 days of the sale. (5) Both parties must submit the required documents to the registering authority.
